data.title: Veľkomoravské hradiská – a new book from Dajama
data.excerpt: This month the Dajama publishing house brought out a new and exceptionally interesting book, Veľkomoravské hradiská. Our site www.hradiska.sk also contributed to its content.

data.metaDescription: Veľkomoravské hradiská, a new book from the Dajama publishing house, to whose content the hradiska.sk website also contributed. Well worth reading.

children.text: This month the Dajama publishing house brought out a new and exceptionally interesting book – Veľkomoravské hradiská. Our site www.hradiska.sk also contributed to its content. It really is well worth it, so do not hesitate.
